name: Apple Music (Classic 10-band EQ)
notes: Classic Apple Music 'Custom' 10-band graphic EQ (Settings > Music > EQ > Custom on iPhone/iPad, or the EQ pane in the Music app on Mac). Applies system-wide to whatever's connected -- including AirPods -- so it works as a real AirPods EQ even though AirPods themselves have no per-band slider EQ of their own. Long-documented, unchanged in structure for years; continuous gain, no fixed step.
